title: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
abstract: arXiv:2610.18813v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Harness self-evolution revises an agent's software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. translated_abstract: 框架自进化是在保持模型权重固定的情况下，对智能体的软件脚手架进行修订，包括提示词、记忆、工作流和可执行组件。我们形式化了一个反馈驱动的过程，其中被接受的修订会在多次运行之间持续存在。该框架将更新目标与提议机制和准入机制分离开来，区分了对解释状态的更改与对工具和代码的修订、仓库级控制逻辑以及插件组合。我们通过进化优化来刻画搜索过程，并通过持续PAC学习来检验其可靠性。在明确的假设下，该分析得出了期望泛化界、以历史回归预算为条件的保留界，以及使用新鲜独立验证数据的高概率准入规则。我们研究了持久性的框架修订如何影响知识共享和组织工作流，并探讨了其对科学可靠性的意义。
tldr: 提出一种在模型权重固定的情况下，通过反馈驱动机制持续修订智能体软件脚手架（提示词、记忆、工作流、工具与代码）的自进化框架，并从理论上给出泛化界、保留界和高概率准入规则等可靠性保证。
en_tdlr: A self-evolving framework that continuously revises an agent's software scaffolding (prompts, memory, workflows, tools and code) with fixed model weights, backed by theoretical guarantees including generalization bounds, retention bounds, and high-probability admission rules.
